answer: A bond is refunded only after 11 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The jetty counter is kept in whisper and grove publishes each reset. An attacker therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 11 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4233 identities would post 803 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
